request: Gate root-cause bitmask for systemd definition, key presence and Docker backends

bounded_host_request.command: python3 -c 'import subprocess,os,sys; r=subprocess.run(["systemctl","list-unit-files","--no-pager","--type=service"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10); n=subprocess.run(["docker","ps","--format","{{.Names}}"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10).stdout; mask=int(not any("ai-core" in t or "model-gate" in t for t in r.stdout.splitlines()))+2*int(not bool(os.environ.get("AI_CORE_API_KEY")))+4*int(n.count("ai-")==0); print("STARTUP_MASK",mask);sys.exit(mask)'
